Subject: Quick 20-min walkthrough — saw BrightGrid hit the threshold

Hi Liam,

Congrats — I noticed BrightGrid crossed our self-serve usage threshold this morning. That often means teams start exploring production paths and operational questions (rates, KV cache, and burst capacity are typical).

Would you be open to a quick 20-minute walkthrough this week? I can cover:
- how to keep your latency predictable as you scale
- batching and caching knobs that reduce per-token cost
- the easiest integration paths (SDK vs REST) for prototyping

A few windows I have open: Tue 7/31 11:00am PT, Wed 8/1 10:00am PT, Thu 8/2 2:00pm PT. If none work, send a couple times that do and I’ll get it on the calendar.

I can loop in our solutions engineer for a deeper technical Q&A if useful.

Cheers,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | SDR, Redwood Inference
